headline: Copymind dropped email verification before its paywall and moved to a dark paywall with an auto-applied promo code. Breeze and Simply Piano made small tweaks. This run every funnel was walked through to its paywall.

what_changed.copymind: Email verification before the paywall removed; paywall now dark with an auto-applied promo code (4 weeks $19.99, then $39.99).
what_changed.breeze: Paywall still “choose any amount” ($1–$17.34); the small print under it was rewritten. Age and gender questions swapped. 1 new ad link.
what_changed.simply-piano: One question removed (“For how long have you had a piano/keyboard?”). Paywall now captured behind the free-book popup.
what_changed.imprint: No screen changes. Paywall captured for the first time (Quarterly $16.99 with a SUMMER2026 promo). Ads: +140 active (740 now).
what_changed.yousician: No screen changes. Paywall captured for the first time, after a test sign-up (7-day trial, then $159.99/year).
what_changed.learna: No screen changes. Ads: 46 new in two weeks, +480 active (644 now).
what_changed.memoryos: No screen changes. Ad links changed: new new-h2 funnel, mos_cfg seniors_s → read003b, seniors_o removed.
what_changed.smartyme: No screen changes. Ads: 51 new in two weeks, −91 active (109 now).
what_changed.simply-sing: No screen changes. Its funnel from ads (singyourheartout) reaches the same paywall as Simply Piano.

hide_funnels.reason: First-question options are shuffled; this run the walk took the adult branch, last run the child branch. The adult branch matches hellosimply.com/family/esa.

screens.title: Age is now asked first
notes: “Choose your age” is now screen 1 and “What is your gender identity?” screen 2; last run the order was reversed.

screens.title: Same “choose any amount” paywall, small print rewritten
notes: The price picker is unchanged: $1, $2, $10 or $17.34.

The line under it changed from “It costs us $17.34 to provide this trial offer, but we want you to choose what feels right for you” to “No charge on this page. By clicking continue, you are choosing the amount for your introductory offer. Please review conditions at the next screen.”

screens.title: Question removed: “For how long have you had a piano/keyboard?”
notes: This question is no longer in the funnel; the rest of the order is unchanged.

screens.title: Free-book popup over the paywall
notes: “Welcome Freebie!”: the “Pianist Must Haves” book (worth US$19.90) for free. The walk now closes it and captures the paywall behind it.

screens.title: Paywall, now captured behind the popup
notes: Last run only the popup was captured.

“Start your 7-day free trial”: Family $17.49/mo (save 50%, $209.90 billed annually) or Individual $14.16/mo (save 43%, $169.90 billed annually), a 50% discount timer and a toggle to extend the trial to 14 days.

screens.title: Paywall: dark theme and an auto-applied promo code
notes: The paywall is now dark, headed “Your Plan Is Set!”, with a “Your promo code applied!” banner and a 10-minute timer.
Plans: 1 week $9.99, then $39.99 every 4 weeks; 4 weeks $19.99 (crossed-out $39.99); 12 weeks $39.99 (crossed-out $79.99).

screens.title: Email verification screen removed
notes: “Verify your email” no longer appears between the email step and the paywall.

screens.title: Paywall captured for the first time
notes: Last run the walk stopped at the email step, so there is nothing to compare yet.

“Choose a plan” with “SUMMER2026” promo code applied: Monthly $11.99 first month ($23.99), Quarterly $16.99 first 3 months ($42.99, most popular), Annual $49.99 first year ($99.99); 30-day money-back guarantee.

screens.title: Paywall captured for the first time (after creating a test account)
notes: Last run the walk stopped at “Create your account”.
“Start your 7-day free trial”: Yearly plan $13.33/month, $159.99/year, “Save 50%”, PayPal / Google Pay / card.

ideas.title: Test going from email straight to the paywall in Vocal 2.0 and Drawing, without the code.
ideas.detail: It should move Email → Paywall (19–25% there now).

ideas.title: Show an auto-applied promo code with a 10-minute timer on the paywall.
ideas.seen_in: Copymind; Imprint and Chillio do the same

ideas.title: Reframe the Vocal 2.0 and Drawing email gate as "Your results are ready" with a blurred preview.
ideas.detail: It should move Loader → Email (12–13% vs 35% in Scanner).

findings: All 3 Skillsta funnels still have an email-code screen before the paywall. Copymind, the only competitor that had one, removed it this run.
Loader → Email is weakest in Vocal 2.0 and Drawing (12–13% vs 35% in Scanner, which frames email as "your results are ready").
Email → Paywall: 99% in Scanner but 19–25% in Vocal 2.0 and Drawing. Worth investigating.
Auto-applied promo codes with a countdown are spreading: Copymind added one this run; Imprint (SUMMER2026) and Chillio (scratch card) already do it.
Vocal Scanner starts tripled (13,481 vs 4,581), so read its conversion changes with care.
